title: The Day of the Loose Button
skyStory: Second day of the moon in Virgo, eighty-six percent bright and sitting cross-legged with a needle and thread. Virgo has found every loose button in the region and wants them reattached by sundown. It hums while it works. Saturn holds the thimble. Mars, who has never once sewn anything, is watching with real respect. The waning light is soft and patient.

reading: Something small around you is loose. A button hanging by one thread. A cabinet hinge that squeaks. A wobbly chair leg. The Tiger usually ignores these until they become a whole thing. Today Virgo asks you to fix one, slowly, with your full attention. It takes nine minutes. It feels like an hour of calm.

Then coast. After a big full moon weekend, Monday wants you easy. [[The Hanged Man]] dangles from a tree, totally relaxed, seeing the world from a fresh angle. Borrow his view: look at your to-do list upside down for thirty seconds. Everything on it looks funnier from down there.
joel.mission: Fix one small loose thing today, a button, a hinge, a wobble, and give it a name afterward.
joel.omen: A single thread on your sleeve. It means a small, helpful connection is about to form.
joel.stoneWhy: patient as a needle and thread
joel.elementWhy: a soft breeze for a soft Monday

reading: The shore is quiet after the big moon, the tide pulled back, leaving little treasures at the edge of the ice: a smooth stone, a bit of sea glass, a shell with a hole in it. Today is a gathering day, not a doing day. Collect small good things, real or otherwise.

Around 1 pm someone will compliment you, probably your hands, or your stories, or how you explained something. Do not deflect it. Do not say oh, it was nothing. Say thank you and nothing else. The [[Page of Pentacles]] is studying how you receive, and today you get an A.
nancy.mission: Collect three small good things today, an object, a sentence, a moment, and tell them to Joel tonight.
nancy.omen: Sea glass, or anything that looks like it. It means something rough in your week is turning smooth.

together.text: After the big full moon, declare a soft Monday. Each of you does one thing slower than necessary and one thing kinder than necessary, then reports both in a single sentence. Virgo will tidy the report. Saturn will file it under excellent.

game.intro: A button is hanging by one thread and so is Saturn's patience. Rest day rules: answer fast, then nap.
